source_row.rationale: Fever with an itchy rash showing lesions in multiple different stages simultaneously (macules, papules, vesicles, and crusts — described as having a "dew drop on a rose petal" appearance) is the classic presentation of varicella (chickenpox), a highly contagious viral infection requiring both airborne and contact precautions until all lesions have crusted over.
source_row.source_detail: Classic Rash Pattern and Precaution Requirements for Varicella

source_row.stem: A child presents with fever and an itchy rash consisting of lesions in various stages, including macules, papules, vesicles, and crusts, appearing simultaneously across the body, and a parent assumes this is just a heat rash that doesn't require anything more than home care.
